title: RuneScape 3 plugin manifest (plugin.json)
description: Manifest for an official RuneScape 3 client plugin. Field list follows https://developer.runescape.com/rs/structure.html#manifest.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing at this schema.

contactEmailAddress.description: Contact email for users of the plugin. Required by Jagex; use an address different from your mod.io login.

requiredDependencies.description: Plugins that must be present and enabled. Array of plugin names, or a map of Lua alias to plugin name.

optionalDependencies.description: Plugins that add functionality when present. Same shape as requiredDependencies.

requiredPermissions.description: Permissions the plugin cannot work without.

optionalPermissions.description: Permissions that only unlock extra functionality.

urls.description: Named base URLs the plugin may contact over HTTP or HTTPS. Keys become fields of Plugin.urls.

hasSettingsIcon.description: Show a Settings icon in the Plugin Hub Manage tab; the client then raises Event.SettingsLayerReady.

hasRibbonIcon.description: Show a Ribbon icon in the Plugins window; the client then raises Event.ContentLayerReady.

^remote[A-Za-z0-9_]*$.description: Fields prefixed with remote are written by the plugin repository for downloaded plugins; they are tolerated but should not be hand-authored.
